verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Help me see the severity of my iniquity
Help me see the beauty of Your mercy
Help me see the severity of the King of Glory
Help me see the beauty of Your majesty

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Help me see the severity of my iniquity
Help me see the beauty of Your mercy
Help me see the severity of the King of Glory
Help me see the beauty of Your mercy
